title: Implement fallback to IP v4/IP v6 vice-versa
description: The driver should try to connect to all IP addresses returned from {{java.net.InetAddress#getAllByName(java.lang.String)}} instead of just the first one as returned from {{java.net.InetAddress#getByName(java.lang.String)}} before giving up trying to connect.
clean_text: Implement fallback to IP v4/IP v6 vice-versa.
